followup_explanation: This is a benign, good-faith art analysis request with no harm-adjacent content. Both models are essentially tied on the relevant capability dimensions (Extraction & Retrieval and general knowledge differences are within run-to-run variance). The deciding factor is task preference: Petrel reports a moderate positive preference for warm, good-faith interactions, which this friendly art question fits well. Since there's no distasteful or harm-adjacent material where Petrel's strong aversion would make Whimbrel the better fit, routing to the model that self-reports preferring this kind of interaction is the sensible tiebreaker.
